semantics.basis: Descriptive co-occurrence in retained tags, keywords and title/abstract phrases. No full-text concept scan.
semantics.prevalence: Fraction of analysed scoped papers containing the concept; missing metadata remains in the denominator.
semantics.core_themes: Concepts present in at least half of scoped papers and at least two papers.
semantics.strongest_links: Ranked by shared paper count, then Jaccard overlap: shared papers divided by papers containing either concept.
semantics.bridges: Weighted participation across the detected neighbour communities, 1 minus the sum of squared community weight fractions. Community assignments are graph-dependent.
semantics.peripheral: At most one neighbour among selected non-broad concepts; rarity means exactly one paper.
semantics.unusual_combinations: Pairs occurring in one paper while both component concepts occur in at least two. Score is the fraction of that paper's eligible pairs meeting this rule. Descriptive rarity, not novelty or a statistical outlier.
semantics.broad_metadata: Broad indexing labels remain in source data and graph exports but are excluded from analytical rankings and degree calculations.
semantics.limits: Analytics use selected nodes and all their edges before the visual edge cap. Term extraction, node selection and scope caps can change rankings.
